instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova is a mid-sized property and casualty insurance carrier specializing in auto, home, and SME liability. With 90,000 policies in force, the company operates within highly regulated environments that demand rigorous compliance and solvency standards. The firm is currently focused on leveraging its existing data infrastructure to improve risk assessment models while navigating increasing claims complexity.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This project involved deep collaboration between product, compliance, and customer success teams, demonstrating successful integration of user experience into core processes. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: Recent internal audits indicated significant friction between the legacy claims system and new data analytics initiatives, slowing cross-departmental adoption. Management is currently focused on proving the value of the innovation squad to secure sustained investment.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Agent Network Data Monetization Pilot
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing network of 200 independent agents offers a low-risk avenue for diversification by providing B2B service opportunities. This aligns with conservative risk appetite and utilizes current operational assets rather than requiring massive infrastructure overhaul.

first_actions: Identify three high-potential agent segments for data sharing trials
Establish a legal framework for third-party data exchange
Define KPIs focused on lead generation volume
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 20 qualified B2B leads from pilot agents within Q3
milestones: Q1: Framework approval and segment selection complete
Q2: Pilot program launch across three segments
Q3: KPI review and scalability assessment

opportunities.title: Adjacent Wellness Product Exploration (Micro-Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Given the structural decline in traditional P&C, exploring partnerships for ancillary health and wellness products presents a safe diversification path. This incremental approach minimizes regulatory risk while tapping into growing consumer demand.

first_actions: Conduct market sizing studies on niche coverage gaps
Develop a partnership proposal outlining shared risk structure
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure a formal MOU or partnership agreement with at least one wellness provider within 4 months
milestones: Q1: Partner identification and initial due diligence complete
Q2: Finalize terms and operational alignment for pilot product

opportunities.title: Internal Process Optimization via Low-Code Automation
opportunities.rationale: To address the 'process' barrier, implementing low-code automation within existing core systems will improve efficiency and reduce operational costs without requiring a full system replacement. This is a foundational step for future innovation velocity.

first_actions: Select three high-friction internal processes (e.g., report generation)
Train the innovation squad on specific low-code tools (e.g., Zapier/Power Automate)
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Subscription costs for low-code platforms ($10k estimate)
Training time for existing IT staff
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average processing time for the selected processes by 30% within 5 months
milestones: Q2: Automation PoC completion and validation
Q3: Rollout of first two automated workflows
Q4: Full review of efficiency gains

next_steps.action: Hold a cross-functional workshop to define the scope and resource allocation for the Agent Network Data Monetization Pilot.
Finalize the regulatory risk assessment and partnership criteria for Health/Wellness product exploration.

key_weaknesses: High internal friction between legacy systems and new data initiatives, slowing adoption.
Limited innovation pipeline due to a 'partial' innovation process lacking standardized entry/exit criteria.
Risk appetite is too conservative, potentially stifling radical diversification opportunities.
Underutilization of existing agent network assets for non-core revenue generation.
